en-US.longDescription: Genome sequencing is generating vast amounts of DNA sequence data from a wide range of organisms. As a result, gene sequence databases are growing rapidly. In order to conduct efficient analyses of these data, there is a need for easy-to-use computer programs, containing fast computational algorithms and useful statistical methods. The objective of the MEGA software has been to provide tools for exploring, discovering, and analyzing DNA and protein sequences from an evolutionary perspective.
en-US.name: MEGA12

zh-CN.longDescription: 基因组测序技术正从各类生物体中产生海量的 DNA 序列数据，导致基因序列数据库迅速膨胀。为高效分析这些数据，亟需配备快速计算算法和实用统计方法的易用计算机程序。MEGA 软件的目标正是提供从进化角度探索、发现和分析 DNA 及蛋白质序列的研究工具。
